title: Prototype Blocks: Utility
description: This resource pack changes the utility and some of the functional blocks into their in-development textures.
body:
This resource pack changes the utility and some of the functional blocks into their in-development textures. This Rescource pack is a follow-up of the [Beta Enchanting Table](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/beta-enchanting-table) texture pack.
<u>Use Minecraft's built-in texturepack: "programmer art" for the best expirience.</u>
![pack order](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12c629fcaa4676b95f61a2de776b5666198dd337.png)
 Updates will be made in the future, another texturepack related to this will be released soon!
